references.label: Top advance rollover
references.description: The top rollover advances and activates bumper scoring before the plunge enters a MAGIC lane.
references.context: Plunge across the top Advance and On Bumpers rollover.

references.label: MAGIC lanes
references.description: Five upper lanes spell MAGIC and score the game's largest standard lane value.
references.context: Guide the plunge into an unlit MAGIC lane.

references.label: Upper bumper cluster
references.description: The three upper bumpers can move the ball through multiple MAGIC lanes.
references.context: Nudge above the three upper bumpers.

references.label: Center star target
references.description: The center standup advances MAGIC before completion and awards the star after MAGIC is complete.
references.context: Shoot the center standup target after completing MAGIC.

references.label: Lit blue bumper
references.description: The upper blue bumper scores 100 after the center star is collected.
references.context: Return up top and score the lit upper blue bumper.

references.label: CITY award letters
references.description: CITY qualifies replay on Magic City or an added-ball award on Magic Town.
references.context: Use CITY only when its installed award is useful.
